verdict.rationale: Background automation is a fair question for an accounting SaaS, but the pack shows no user-configurable automations, rules, or recurring schedules. What it does show is adjacent: automatic booking-category suggestions and asset recognition are built-in behaviours, partner integrations that 'transfer data automatically' are a third-party feature, and the REST API is a developer building block. None of these count as the user setting up autonomous automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
